adjudicated_statement:
SCOPE. Work over C with Q-coefficients at (g,n) = (6,6). Let X := M_{6,6}, the smooth separated Deligne-Mumford stack of smooth genus-six curves with six ordered marked points, of pure dimension d = 21, with finite inertia and quasi-projective coarse space. Let T := W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(X;Q), identified by Poincare duality (FND-0001) with W_{26}H^{26}(X;Q)(21), pure polarizable of weight -16. Let Y be the atlas-independent reduced closed substack of X named by the verified C66-SUPPORT-INTERFACE datum (ATT-0120/CLM-0120-2), and let T_Z := ker(r_T) be its named subobject of T, where r_T : T -> W_{26}H^{26}(X minus Y;Q)(21) is W_{26} of ordinary open restriction twisted by (21) (ATT-0120/CLM-0120-3, CLM-0120-4). No dimension, purity, irreducibility, regular-immersion, or lci property of Y is assumed or used. Call a chain Y = Y^(0) superset Y^(1) superset ... superset Y^(N) = empty of reduced closed substacks of X admissible if the dimensions n_j := dim Y^(j) strictly decrease and, for every j, S_j := Y^(j) minus Y^(j+1) is smooth of pure dimension n_j, has affine coarse space, and is closed in X minus Y^(j+1).

LOAD-BEARING IMPORTED INPUTS, to be carried by every downstream citation. (S1) Ordinary Q-cohomology of smooth separated finite-type DM stacks over C carries functorial mixed Hodge structures with H^m of weights at least m. (S2) The purity (Gysin) long exact sequence of mixed Hodge structures for a smooth closed substack of pure codimension c in a smooth DM stack. (S1) and (S2) are stack-level statements imported from V-manifold/orbifold Hodge theory via an etale atlas and Q-descent; they are not proved in the originating artifact. (S3) Rational coarse comparison H^*(S;Q) = H^*(S^c;Q) for separated finite-inertia DM stacks over C (Behrend, Cohomology of Stacks, Proposition 36). (S4) Artin vanishing H^k(A;Q) = 0 for k > dim A for a possibly singular complex affine variety A (Esnault, Variation on Artin's vanishing theorem, Theorem 2.1). (S5) Strictness of morphisms of mixed Hodge structures for W, hence exactness of W_m. (S6) Semisimplicity of pure polarizable rational Hodge structures of a fixed weight (FND-0033).

CLAIMS. (1) An admissible chain for Y exists. It is constructed by removing, at each stage, the components of Y^(j) of dimension below n_j, the pairwise intersections of the top-dimensional components, and Sing(Y^(j)), then taking the substack lying over a dense affine open of the coarse space of each remaining top-dimensional component; Y^(j+1) is the reduced complement. The construction uses no dimension bound for Y (in particular FND-0181 and FND-0187 are not load-bearing here) and asserts affineness only of stratum coarse spaces, never of a stratum stack or of an open of an affine stack.

(2) For every admissible chain, A_j := ker(T -> W_{26}H^{26}(X minus Y^(j);Q)(21)) is a finite decreasing filtration of T by sub-Hodge structures with A_0 = T_Z and A_N = 0, and each graded piece A_j/A_{j+1} is a subquotient of the pure polarizable weight -16 Hodge structure W_{2n_j-16}H^{2n_j-16}(S_j;Q)(n_j). This follows from (S2) applied to the smooth pair (X minus Y^(j+1), S_j) in degree 26 and codimension 21 - n_j, exactness of W_{26} by (S5), and the weight bound of (S1), using 26 - 2(21-n_j) = 2n_j - 16 and (-(21-n_j)) + 21 = n_j. Only a subquotient is claimed; no supports group is named, and no supports group is identified with its image in T, so the FND-0168(3a)/(3b) hazard is not incurred.

(3) For every admissible chain, A_j/A_{j+1} = 0 when n_j <= 7, because the ordinary degree 2n_j - 16 is negative; A_j/A_{j+1} = 0 when n_j >= 17, because then 2n_j - 16 > n_j = dim S_j = dim S_j^c and (S3) followed by (S4) on the affine coarse space kills H^{2n_j-16}(S_j;Q); and A_j/A_{j+1} is a finite direct sum of Q(8), possibly zero, when n_j = 8, being a subquotient of H^0(S_j;Q)(8) and hence such a sum by (S6). Both vanishings are degree comparisons, not inferences from smallness of stratum dimension.

(4) For every admissible chain, T_Z is isomorphic, not necessarily canonically, to the direct sum of the graded pieces A_j/A_{j+1} indexed by those j with n_j in {8, ..., 16}, the splitting being supplied by (S6). Strict decrease of the n_j means at most one stratum occurs per dimension, so at most nine pieces survive, of which at most eight lie in the range 9 <= n_j <= 16. T_Z depends only on the pair (X, Y) (ATT-0120/CLM-0120-6), but the individual residual strata S_j with 9 <= n_j <= 16 depend on the chosen chain; no chain is canonical and none is needed.

(5) T_Z is a finite direct sum of Q(8) if and only if, for one admissible chain -- equivalently, by (4), for every admissible chain -- every graded piece A_j/A_{j+1} with 9 <= n_j <= 16 is a finite direct sum of Q(8). The 'if' direction is the sufficiency implication proved in the originating artifact. The 'only if' direction holds because A_j is contained in A_0 = T_Z for every j, so each graded piece is a subquotient of T_Z, and by (S6) every subquotient of a finite direct sum of Q(8) is again one.

(6) A strictly stronger, merely sufficient antecedent. If W_{2n_j-16}H^{2n_j-16}(S_j;Q) is a finite direct sum of Q(8-n_j) for every residual stratum, then by the twist identity Q(8-n_j)(n_j) = Q(8), clause (2) and (S6), each residual graded piece is a finite direct sum of Q(8) and clause (5) applies. This stratum-level condition is NOT necessary: the graded piece is only a subquotient of that group, so a non-Tate stratum group is compatible with Tate graded pieces. The residual obligation isolated by this result is therefore Tate control of the graded pieces A_j/A_{j+1} for 9 <= n_j <= 16, which is the assigned obligation of C66-TATE-SUPPORT; stratum-level Tate control is one sufficient route to it.

WHAT IS AND IS NOT AVOIDED. The argument does use the purity (Gysin) long exact sequence for the constructed smooth pairs (X minus Y^(j+1), S_j), as the assigned theorem expressly permits. What it avoids is any Gysin map, fundamental class, regular immersion, closed embedding, expected-codimension bookkeeping, or codimension shift for Y itself or for any model of Z inside X (FND-0052, FND-0168(5)), and any Borel-Moore or compact-support mixed Hodge formalism on the singular stack Y (FND-0165), replaced throughout by ordinary cohomology of smooth stacks.

NOT ASSERTED. No Tate type for T_Z or for T; clause (5) is an equivalence between two open conditions, not a determination of either. No lower bound on T_Z: T_Z = 0 is compatible with clauses (1) through (6), all direct sums then being empty. No support exhaustion T_Z = T. No preferred admissible chain and no chain-independence of the residual strata. No realization of an adjudicated proper non-Tate model as a single admissible stratum, a proper support being inadmissible because it is not affine. No assembly of complementary target terms, and nothing about RED-0001.

GENERALITY. Nothing above is specific to (6,6). For any reduced closed substack Y of a smooth separated finite-type DM stack X over C of pure dimension d with finite inertia and quasi-projective coarse space, and any even ordinary degree m, the same construction and argument give a filtration whose graded pieces are subquotients of W_{m-2(d-n_j)}H^{m-2(d-n_j)}(S_j;Q)(n_j - d + m/2), vanishing for n_j < d - m/2 and for n_j > 2d - m, and of type a finite direct sum of Q(d - m/2) at n_j = d - m/2. The recorded case d = 21, m = 26 yields the thresholds n_j <= 7 and n_j >= 17 and the Q(8) endpoint at n_j = 8.
contradiction_resolution:
MANDATORY FIRST READS. proof/attempts/ATT-0130.json and proof/reviews/REV-0180.json were inspected before the packet and the findings backlog. FND-0192 is the single finding_candidate recorded in REV-0180 (key affine-peeling-support-filtration-for-ce-kernel); its statement paraphrases ATT-0130 claims CLM-0130-1 through CLM-0130-5, all of which REV-0180 marks confirmed at review_pass 1. The contested passages are ATT-0130 sections 1 through 5 of argument_markdown, which I re-derived line by line rather than accepting REV-0180's verdict.

WHY AN INDEPENDENT RE-DERIVATION WAS REQUIRED. FND-0192 carries evidence_class adversarial_review with reviewer_engines = [qwen], and TASK.json lists qwen in excluded_engines for campaign revision 6. The finding therefore rested on a single confirming review from an engine now excluded from the pool. This audit supplies the independent second check.

RE-DERIVATION OF THE FIVE CLAUSES. (i) Lemma 1: at each stage removing lower-dimensional components, pairwise intersections of top-dimensional components, and Sing(Y^(j)) leaves O open, smooth, pure of dimension d_j, dense in each top-dimensional C_a, with the pieces O cap C_a pairwise disjoint. Since the coarse space of X is quasi-projective, each (O cap C_a)^c is quasi-projective and irreducible, hence contains a dense affine open A_a; a finite disjoint union of affine schemes is affine, so S_j (the substack over A) is smooth of pure dimension d_j with affine coarse space. S_j is open in Y^(j), so Y^(j+1) := (Y^(j) minus S_j)_red is closed in Y^(j) hence in X, and S_j = Y^(j) cap (X minus Y^(j+1)) is closed in X minus Y^(j+1). Y^(j+1) is the union of the lower-dimensional components with the proper closed subsets C_a minus S_j, so dim Y^(j+1) <= d_j - 1; strict decrease of a nonnegative integer forces termination. Confirmed, and confirmed to use no dimension bound for Y and no 'open of an affine stack is affine' step (affineness is asserted of the coarse space only, which is exactly the archive constraint at issue).
(ii) Lemma 2: V_{j+1} minus S_j = V_j holds because Y^(j) = Y^(j+1) disjoint-union S_j as sets, so (S2) applies to the smooth pair (V_{j+1}, S_j) of pure codimension c_j = 21 - n_j. Arithmetic re-checked: 26 - 2(21 - n_j) = 2n_j - 16; the twist (-c_j) raises the weight floor of H^{2n_j-16}(S_j;Q) from 2n_j-16 to (2n_j-16) + 2(21-n_j) = 26, so W_{26} of the twisted group equals (W_{2n_j-16}H^{2n_j-16}(S_j;Q))(-c_j); and (-c_j) + 21 = n_j with final weight (2n_j-16) - 2n_j = -16. W_{26} is exact by (S5), so it carries ker(H^{26}(V_{j+1}) -> H^{26}(V_j)) = im(H^{2n_j-16}(S_j)(-c_j) -> H^{26}(V_{j+1})) to the corresponding kernel and preserves the surjection onto the image. A_{j+1} subset A_j because the opens enlarge and restriction is functorial; ker(A_j -> W_{26}H^{26}(V_{j+1})(21)) = A_j cap A_{j+1} = A_{j+1}; so A_j/A_{j+1} embeds in a quotient of W_{2n_j-16}H^{2n_j-16}(S_j;Q)(n_j) and is a subquotient of it. A_0 = T_Z by CLM-0120-4 (V_0 = U_Y) and A_N = 0 (V_N = X). Confirmed. Crucially the artifact claims only a subquotient, never an identification with a supports group, so REV-0180's first attack prong and the FND-0168(3a)/(3b) hazard are genuinely avoided; I independently confirm that the connecting map from H^{25}(V_j) can be nonzero in weight 26 and that the weaker subquotient claim is what the argument actually needs.
(iii) n_j <= 7 gives 2n_j - 16 <= -2 < 0. n_j >= 17 gives 2n_j - 16 - n_j = n_j - 16 >= 1, so the degree strictly exceeds dim S_j = dim S_j^c; (S3) reduces to the affine coarse space and (S4) kills it. n_j = 8 gives degree 0, H^0 pure of weight 0 and a finite direct sum of Q, so the graded piece is a subquotient of a finite direct sum of Q(8) and hence such a sum by (S6). Confirmed, including that these are degree comparisons, not appeals to smallness of dimension, so the archive constraint 'positive-codimension strata cannot contribute solely because they have smaller dimension' is not walked.
(iv) Strict decrease gives at most one stratum per dimension; {8,...,16} has nine elements and {9,...,16} has eight, so the counts 'at most nine surviving pieces, at most eight residual' are correct. (S6) supplies a noncanonical splitting of the finite filtration inside a semisimple abelian category, an honest Hodge-structure isomorphism per FND-0033, not a semisimplification. Confirmed.
(v) Sufficiency confirmed, including the twist identity Q(8-n_j)(n_j) = Q(8).

CORRECTIONS APPLIED TO THE CANDIDATE WORDING (the reason the original statement is not promoted unchanged).
(A) 'the only substantive antecedent ... is Tate control of residual strata of dimensions 9 through 16' conflates two different conditions. What ATT-0130 proves sufficient is Tate-ness of the graded pieces A_j/A_{j+1} with 9 <= n_j <= 16. Tate-ness of the strata groups W_{2n_j-16}H^{2n_j-16}(S_j;Q) is strictly stronger and only sufficient, since the graded piece is merely a subquotient of that group; a non-Tate stratum group is fully compatible with Tate graded pieces. The word 'only' is nevertheless defensible at the graded-piece level, but only via an implication ATT-0130 does not state: each A_j (j >= 0) is contained in A_0 = T_Z, so each graded piece is a subquotient of T_Z, and by (S6) T_Z a finite direct sum of Q(8) forces every graded piece to be one. I have added that converse explicitly and marked it as audit-supplied, so clause (5) below is now a genuine biconditional at the graded-piece level and only a one-way implication at the stratum level.
(B) 'no Gysin map for Y or Z ... is required' is true as scoped but reads as though no Gysin-type input at all is used. The proof does use the purity/Gysin long exact sequence for the constructed smooth pairs (X minus Y^(j+1), S_j) — ATT-0130's own gloss 'It is not a Gysin map' is rhetorical; the map H^{m-2c}(S)(-c) -> H^m(V) is the Gysin pushforward for that smooth pair, which the assigned theorem explicitly permits. Downstream citation must retain the distinction, given the standing FND-0052 and FND-0168(5) hazards about Gysin and closed embeddings for Y and Z.
(C) The candidate omits its hypotheses. Added: ground field C and Q-coefficients; X smooth separated DM of pure dimension 21 with finite inertia and quasi-projective coarse space; affineness is of the stratum coarse space, not of the stratum stack; the splitting is noncanonical and the residual strata are chain-dependent while T_Z is not; every conclusion is compatible with T_Z = 0.
(D) Load-bearing imported inputs not flagged by REV-0180: (S1) the weight bound and (S2) the purity sequence are used at stack level for smooth DM stacks, not merely for smooth varieties. ATT-0130 justifies them by 'passage to an etale scheme atlas ... followed by Q-descent', which is standard V-manifold/orbifold Hodge theory but is an import, not a proof. This is the ordinary-cohomology analogue of the formalism gap FND-0165 records for compact-support and Borel-Moore theory on stacks. ATT-0130 does correctly avoid FND-0165's excluded case (it never applies compact-support or Borel-Moore formalism to the singular Y), but the ordinary stack-level MHS inputs must be carried explicitly. Added to hypotheses.

LOCAL CROSS-CHECKS. No claim-level contradiction: contradicts_claim_ids is empty and the statement opposes none of CONJ-0001, THM-0001 through THM-0007, OBS-0001, or RED-0001 — it asserts no Tate type and no problem-status claim, and resolves_exact_target is false in ATT-0130. Compatible with FND-0001 (used only on M_{6,6} to fix degree/weight/twist; 2*21-16 = 26 and 26-2*21 = -16 re-checked against the TASK.json target dictionary) and with FND-0033 (supplies (S6)). Compatible with FND-0181 (dim Y <= 20) and FND-0187 (the 17-dimensional-model repair), and I confirm ATT-0130's novelty claim that neither is load-bearing: Lemma 1 uses only dim Y^(j) <= dim X, automatic for a closed substack. Distinct from FND-0022 (gonality/Brill-Noether stratification of M_{g,n-1} lacking Gysin assembly, a different stratification of a different space with nonconstant coefficients), FND-0031 (depth-one corner of the Deligne weight spectral sequence on Mbar_{6,6}), FND-0032 (CGP top-weight corner mismatch), FND-0033 (semisimplicity, an input here rather than a duplicate), FND-0165 (compact-support formalism on schemes), and FND-0168 (supports-group-versus-image and Gysin obligations for Y and Z, which this finding respects rather than restates). No entry in proof/findings.jsonl (FND-0001 through FND-0034) or in the packet's adjudicated-findings list carries the equivalence_group affine-peeling-support-filtration-for-ce-kernel or anything cohomologically equivalent to it. Merge target: none.

EXTERNAL VERIFICATION. (S4) is the input I judged most exposed, because ATT-0130 applies it to the coarse space S_j^c, which is in general singular, so Andreotti-Frankel alone would not suffice. Verified in situ: Esnault, 'Variation on Artin's vanishing theorem' (arXiv:math/0406396v1; Adv. Math., doi 10.1016/j.aim.2004.10.023), Theorem 2.1, quoted verbatim from the rendered text: 'Let X be an affine variety defined over the field of complex numbers, and F be a constructible sheaf. Then H^m(X_an, F) = 0 for m > dim(X).' No smoothness hypothesis; the constant sheaf Q_X is constructible. This certifies the n_j >= 17 vanishing exactly as used. Corroborating attribution for the singular case checked at Benoist, 'On the Artin vanishing theorem for Stein spaces' (arXiv:2410.04291), whose abstract I fetched and which is stated for possibly singular Stein spaces, and at Payne, 'Boundary complexes and weight filtrations' (arXiv:1109.4286v1) Section 6, where the affine-variety statement is used with citations to Andreotti-Frankel (1959) and Karcjauskas (1977, 1979).
(S3) is the input REV-0180's second attack prong targets. Verified in situ by reading page 29 of Behrend, 'Cohomology of Stacks': Proposition 36, 'Let X be a topological Deligne-Mumford stack with coarse moduli space Xbar. Then the canonical morphism X -> Xbar induces isomorphisms on Q-valued cohomology groups: H^k(Xbar,Q) -> H^k(X,Q).' The proof reduces to finite-group quotients and uses vanishing of higher group cohomology over Q, which is precisely ATT-0130's (S3) justification. REV-0180's second prong therefore fails for the stated reason.
(S1)/(S5) trace to Deligne, 'Theorie de Hodge : II', Publ. Math. IHES 40 (1971), 5-57, bibliographic data confirmed at the Numdam item page; I did not extract theorem numbers from that page and rely on it only as the primary locator for MHS, the weight bound for smooth varieties, and strictness.
Quasi-projectivity of the coarse space of M_{g,n} was retrieved at arXiv:math/0205009 (Hassett), where a helper located Theorem 2.1 for projectivity of the coarse space of Mbar_{g,n} over Z at weights all one, with M_{g,n} the open locus; I did not verify that theorem number in situ and flag it as helper-located. It is not a contested point in this campaign.
One read-only Grok worker (W-73e1c9594a30, one turn) was used for citation triage on (S4), (S3), and quasi-projectivity; every load-bearing statement it returned was independently re-verified above except the Hassett theorem number, which is flagged. SHA-256 values in source_records were computed by me over the fetched bytes of each URL.

DISPOSITION. The mathematics of all five clauses is correct as re-derived; the defects are wording and omitted hypotheses, not errors of substance. Promote from candidate to corroborated, with evidence_class upgraded from adversarial_review to primary_source and reviewer_engines extended by claude, but only with the corrected and hypothesis-complete statement below, which supersedes the original candidate text.
